title: CI/CD for AI Apps — Use Gates Proportional to Risk
key_insight: Use fast deterministic checks first, then targeted model evaluations for affected behavior, and broader suites before release.
body:
## Use Gates Proportional to Risk

Running every expensive model evaluation on each typo wastes time, but skipping it for prompt changes invites regressions.

Use fast deterministic checks first, then targeted model evaluations for affected behavior, and broader suites before release.

Set explicit pass thresholds and inspect severe cases even when averages pass. Flaky graders need repeated runs or human review, not ignored failures.
common_mistakes: Unit tests alone cover every AI behavior change.
Prompt versions need not be recorded.
Rollback always means changing only application code.
mini_exercise: Draw “Use Gates Proportional to Risk” as three steps and explain each one.
real_world_usage: AI delivery pipelines test code, prompts, models, data contracts, and safety before controlled release.
explain_back_prompt: Use “Use Gates Proportional to Risk” to explain CI/CD for AI Apps plainly.
